mutations.because: K1b's rule is that a segment eases with its STARTING stop's easing (a); an ending stop's own override (b) never applies to the segment before it. Reading b's easing instead makes the segment ease with the wrong stop's override, which the linear-override-on-the-starting-stop fixture's first segment (still ease-out-cubic, despite the ending stop declaring "linear") is built to catch.

K-D9 folds two-or-more tracks on one (layer, property) in DECLARATION order. Folding in reverse is invisible for exactly two operands (IEEE-754 multiplication is exactly commutative for a single pair, and the two-dy-track add fixture is likewise order-blind), which is why the float-order fixture uses three opacity tracks (0.1, 0.2, 0.3): folding them in declaration order gives 1*0.1*0.2*0.3 = 0.006000000000000001, and in reverse gives 1*0.3*0.2*0.1 = 0.006 -- a different double in the last bit, which the fixture asserts exactly.

K1b review: a track's stops must all share one clock, or the resolver silently drops the off-clock stops it was never given a fold-across-clocks meaning for -- data loss with no message. Disabling the mismatch check lets a mixed-clock track back in. Fix round 2 (CodeRabbit): every mixed-clock fixture now uses distinct t values, so this is caught at all three boundaries for the stated reason (a track silently accepted, not the duplicate-t rule firing by coincidence) -- verified individually, file by file, before this command was written to run all three together: tracks.test.ts (2 assertions: the exact refusal object becomes undefined), brief-template.test.ts (isBriefTemplate flips from false to true), load-brief.test.ts (parseBrief stops throwing).

K1b review fix round 2: a beat/effect-clock stop needs a beat to be beat-local against, and only a text layer's pose is resolved per beat (K-D6) -- image/video have no per-beat multiplicity, so such a track has no defined value during a crossfade. Disabling the kind check lets a beat/effect-clock track back onto image/video, caught by the new 'refuses a beat-clock stop on image' / 'refuses an effect-clock stop on video' fixtures.
